title: Pause tick still moves the player
observed: pause+down: the game paused (mode paused, events [pause, move]) but the player moved from (1,1) to (1,2) in the same tick.
expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens, so the player should stay at (1,1).

title: Spike penalty underflows score (100 becomes 65136, later -300)
observed: Spikes at tick 2 took score from 100 to 65136 (wrapped negative value), and later a coin left score at -300, which is outside the 0..999,999 range.
expected: Score is never negative: a spike hit should clamp the score at 0 (100 - 500 gives 0), and score must stay within 0..999,999.

title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast
observed: While paused after a respawn with the 'Key collected' toast showing, btn-resume reports top=false, so something covers it and a click would not reach it.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover the Resume button in the pause menu.

title: Spike hit wraps score instead of clamping at 0
observed: Spike hits do not clamp at 0: score 100 became 65136 at the first spike hit, and the dash into spikes at tick 58 took score from -300 to 64736 while lives correctly dropped to 0.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so the score should be max(0, previous - 500), i.e. 0 here, not 64736.

title: Simultaneous down+right moves player diagonally, two moves in one tick
observed: down+right from (1,2) moved the player to (2,3) with events [move, move], a diagonal move made of two steps in one tick.
expected: Only the last movement key pressed in a tick counts, so the player should make one step right to (2,2).

title: HUD coin counter stale after collecting a coin
observed: After dash-down+up collected a coin, state.coins is 1 but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Restart Level from pause menu leaves the game paused with no dialog
observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, score/lives/timer reset correctly but mode stays 'paused' and no dialog is shown. Further wait tokens change nothing through tick 31, so the game is frozen.
expected: Restart Level puts the level back to its start and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing').

title: Spike hit wraps score to 65136, then goes negative (-300)
observed: At score 100, stepping onto spikes sets score to 65136 (a wrap-around) and lives drop 3->2. Later a coin gives score -300, which is negative.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0: score should be max(0, 100-500)=0. Score must never be negative or wrap around.

title: HUD timer lags one tick behind game timer after Resume
observed: After click:btn-resume the state timeLeft is 299 but the HUD shows Time 300. The HUD still shows the value from before the resume tick.
expected: The HUD always shows the current values, so HUD Time must equal state timeLeft at all times.

title: Spike penalty wraps score to 65136 and later goes to -300
observed: At score 100, a spike hit sets score to 65136 and lives drop to 2. A later coin sets score to -300.
expected: Score is never negative and never wraps; spikes subtract 500 but the score floors at 0.

title: HUD coin counter stuck at 1/5 while state has 2 coins
observed: After dash-down+enter collects a second coin, state coins=2 but the HUD shows 'Coins 1/5'. The mismatch persists through later ticks.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read Coins 2/5.
